summary.text: Kristi Burke, a Democrat and independent muralist, digital content creator and local organizer, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 1st District to Diana Harshbarger.
She won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Burke says she was raised with a foundation in the church and taught to care for the vulnerable.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as an independent muralist, digital content creator, and local organizer; in her Candidate Connection survey she says she has worked in the beauty industry, painted large-scale murals, and built a YouTube platform focused on critical thinking.
She describes herself as a renter without health insurance who has spent years working to climb out of debt.
Burke won the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary with 76.6% of the vote, ahead of David Kerr Jr. and Herman Garcia.
During the campaign, she described her campaign as a challenge to policies that she says put corporate profits ahead of residents' needs such as healthcare and housing.
She received 29.5% of the vote to Diana Harshbarger's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
